title: Provident fund wage ceiling and membership limits
description: The wage ceiling the Central Government notifies under section 2(89) of the Code on Social Security, 2020 for becoming a member under Chapter III, and the monthly wage or pay limits that make an employee an excluded employee of the Provident Fund or admit him to the Pension Scheme, each in its instrument's words. Until 28 June 2026 the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952 and the Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995, continued by section 164(2) of the Code, write the amounts; from 29 June 2026 the Schemes of 2026 tie them to the wage ceiling: ₹15,000 under S.O. 2702(E) of 29 May 2026, the first notification under section 2(89) read, and ₹25,000 from 17 September 2026 under S.O. 5109(E). The Scheme of 2026 holds no limit for a person with disability, and its limit does not make an International Worker an excluded employee. A wage month a version divides is split by the payroll as EPFO instructs.

choices.title: The wage ceiling for Chapter III
Excluded from the Fund when the wage is above it
A member of the Pension Scheme when the wage is at most it

cells.name: Wage ceiling for Chapter III of the Code on Social Security, 2020
cells.wording: Code on Social Security, 2020, section 2(89): “wage ceiling” means such amount of wages as may be notified by the Central Government, for the purposes of becoming a member under Chapter III and Chapter IV; S.O. 2702(E): In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (89) of section 2 of the Code on Social Security, 2020 (36 of 2020), the Central Government hereby notifies rupees fifteen thousand (₹15,000) per month as the wage ceiling for the purposes of Chapter III of the said Code.

rows.source: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, paragraph 2(f)(i), as corrected by G.S.R. 703(E), item 1(ii), and paragraph 9(3); the wage ceiling of S.O. 2702(E), 29 May 2026

cells.name: Excluded employee of the Provident Fund: his wage when he would become a member
cells.wording: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, paragraph 2(f)(i), as corrected: “Excluded employee” means,- (i) an employee other than the International Worker whose wage at the time he is otherwise entitled to become a member of the Fund, exceeds wage ceiling as prescribed under the Code; Paragraph 9(3): Every excluded employee or an exempted employee shall become a member of this Fund forthwith on ceasing to be an excluded employee or an exempted employee. S.O. 2702(E): … the Central Government hereby notifies rupees fifteen thousand (₹15,000) per month as the wage ceiling for the purposes of Chapter III of the said Code.

rows.source: Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026, paragraph 7(1)(i); the wage ceiling of S.O. 2702(E), 29 May 2026

cells.name: Member of the Pension Scheme: his wages when he becomes a member of the Provident Fund
cells.wording: Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026, paragraph 7(1): This Scheme shall apply to every employee … (i) who, on or after the date of notification of this Scheme, becomes a member of the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026 or the Provident Fund of the establishment which is exempted under section 143 of the Code and whose wages on such date is less than or equal to wage ceiling notified by the Central Government; S.O. 2702(E): … the Central Government hereby notifies rupees fifteen thousand (₹15,000) per month as the wage ceiling for the purposes of Chapter III of the said Code.

rows.source: S.O. 5109(E), 17 September 2026, under section 2(89) of the Code on Social Security, 2020, superseding S.O. 2702(E)

cells.name: Wage ceiling for Chapter III of the Code on Social Security, 2020
cells.wording: Code on Social Security, 2020, section 2(89): “wage ceiling” means such amount of wages as may be notified by the Central Government, for the purposes of becoming a member under Chapter III and Chapter IV; S.O. 5109(E): In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (89) of section 2 of the Code on Social Security, 2020 (36 of 2020) and in supersession of the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Labour and Employment, number S.O. 2702(E) dated 29th May 2026, except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the Central Government hereby notifies rupees twenty-five thousand (₹25,000) per month as the wage ceiling for the purposes of Chapter III of the said Code, with effect from the date of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette.
